fields.Name: T33 - Data Explorer Browse Legislative Issues
fields.Description: Verifies that the Legislative Issues entity opens from the Data Explorer entity tree and displays a populated grid of legislative issue records.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box) and go to Data Explorer, then its Data section. In the left-hand entity tree locate the 'Legislative Issues' entity and click it. Wait patiently if the grid is slow to load (pages can take 10-30s in this resource-constrained environment). Success is reached when a grid of multiple legislative issue records is displayed, such as 'Dairy Pricing Reform Act'.

judgeValidationCriteria: The 'Legislative Issues' entity is selected in the Data Explorer Data section
A row grid is shown with multiple legislative issue records (more than one row)
At least one recognizable issue title (e.g. 'Dairy Pricing Reform Act' or 'Food Labeling Modernization Act') is visible
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
